title: LASTNONBLANK returns the last value of the column for which the measure is not BLANK

source.quote: Returns the last value in the column for which the expression has a non blank value.
source.supports: the last value whose expression is not blank

derivation: Products in order: Bike, Helmet, Lock, Scooter. Scooter has no sales, so its measure is BLANK; Lock is 80 (rows 4, 6). The last non-blank is Lock.
